name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Develop the Domain Graph visualization using the D3.js library and integrate it with the UniProt API.

Design a linear sequence-level viewer to map PTMs onto protein domains.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
PTM-WEB is a comprehensive bioinformatics knowledge-base and visualization dashboard designed to analyze Post-Translational Modifications (PTMs), Protein-Protein Interactions, Signaling Pathways, and Protein Domains.

Domain Graph Visualization: A detailed linear sequence viewer that maps exact PTM sites (e.g., Acetylation, Phosphorylation) directly onto functional protein domains.
